canonical_title: Pitch control power throughout normal acceleration range

versions.title_at_revision: Pitch control power throughout normal acceleration range
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle, by the use of pitch control alone, is capable of achieving no worse than Level 2 Load Factor Range in a maneuvering flight within the ROSH as specified in MIL- STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Power in Maneuvering Flight paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess pitch control required for a maneuvering flight within the ROSH as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Power in Maneuvering Flight paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess pitch control required for a maneuvering flight within the ROSH as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Power in Maneuvering Flight paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess pitch control required for a maneuvering flight within the ROSH as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Power in Maneuvering Flight paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
